study.purpose: Third and final mechanism-based screen. Two long requests begin first; short requests arrive at 0.50--0.55 s, after the initial long request is expected to enter decode. A forced 256-token decode keeps the long requests active, testing fixed budgets under prefill--decode coexistence rather than only prefill contention.
study.decision_rule: Promote this trace to a full ten-budget confirmation only if its best tested fixed budget differs materially from the delayed-short two-long trace. If not, report that these screened contention states did not establish a trace-dependent static optimum and do not add a second Figure 3 curve.
